text:
sophie_a (AE): FYI Acme is asking for 7yr audit log retention, KMS rotation policy, and an HSM-backed key option. Pricing question and need deal desk sign-off.

mike_se (SalesEng): Do they need per-request signing with the HSM or just key storage?

sophie_a (AE): They want signing for searched PII redaction events (regulator ask). So signing is required.

nina_solutions: For that level we usually recommend the HSM add-on + extended retention tier. Ballpark options: short (90d) included, 1yr add-on, 7yr add-on.

jordan_revops: Need specifics to run numbers. Do we have GB estimate for logs/month?
sophie_a (AE): They expect ~2TB/month ingestion during POC, then ~500GB/mo steady.
jordan_revops: OK. Rough rate card we can propose: 1) Audit-log retention add-on: $0.08/GB-month for tiered up to 1TB, $0.06/GB-month beyond. 2) Long-retention archive (>=3yrs): $15k/mo flat for up to 50TB archival with compliance retrieval SLA. 3) HSM-backed KMS: $3k/mo per HSM instance + $0.003/crypto-op. 4) KMS-only (software-managed keys): $0/mo base + $0.0005/crypto-op.

mike_se (SalesEng): callout: the per-crypto-op price above is for signing ops. If they are heavy (e.g., 100k sign/sec) we should model commit and dedicated capacity.

sophie_a (AE): They asked about discounts for 12m commit. What do we normally offer?
jordan_revops: For enterprise commits >= $250k ARR we can consider 15% off platform + 10% off add-ons. For > $1M ARR consider 25% off. Exceptions need tim_legal sign-off.
tim_legal: Confirming: any discount affecting audit/audit-log retention needs to preserve compliance commitments in contract. Also HSM is a special service — require SOW language around key custody and service windows.
nina_solutions: For POC we can offer a trial: 3 months of extended retention capped at 5TB to validate, then convert to billed tier on go-live. That helps them pilot without full commit.
sophie_a (AE): Customer asks if we can bundle HSM with 12m 50% commit for discounted price. Proposed: $2k/mo per HSM if they commit 12mo at $500k ARR. Is that plausible?
jordan_revops: That's steep discount on HSM. Acceptable only with a carve-out: require minimum 2 HSMs reserved + non-refundable onboarding fee $25k. If you want to push that, escalate to revenue director.
mike_se (SalesEng): Operational note: HSM onboarding lead time is ~4 weeks. Add to SOW timelines.
ops-bot: Reminder: create deal desk ticket with template 'enterprise-addons' and include estimated GB, commit level, and SOW draft.
sophie_a (AE): I'll open the ticket and add POC dates + expected 2TB/month spike.
tim_legal: I'll draft the SOW clauses for HSM custody, rotation policy, and audit access. Send to me before the end of week.
jordan_revops: Once ticket's in, I'll do a final price calc and decision on discounts. If pricing delta > 20% from standard, need exec approval.
sophie_a (AE): Thanks team — will follow up with ticket link and attach customer's SOC2/HIPAA questionnaire answers we received.
nina_solutions: Quick Q: should we propose a retrieval SLA for archived logs? Customers often demand 24-48h. That affects cost.
jordan_revops: Yes include 48h standard; 24h available as premium at +30% archive fee.
sophie_a (AE): Noted. I'll capture those options in the quote.
